label: Front Yard
title: Landscape Plan - Front Yard
description: Street frontage on Ten Oak Court, the entry walk, foundation beds around the existing residence, a sod lawn, and the borders along both wood fences.

label: Back Yard
title: Landscape Plan - Back Yard
description: The existing pool and aggregate-concrete terrace, a sod lawn, rose plantings, the oak and pine canopies along the rear property line, and the flower-box terrace by the shed.

discrepancies.note: The legend calls for 8 Gaiety Girl Tea Tree but only three callouts are legible on the drawing - LS/3, LS/2 and LS/1, totalling 6. A fourth callout for the remaining 2 was not found. The sheet has a crease and glare across part of the plan and it is most likely lost there. Rather than invent a location, the gap is recorded here.
